constants.name: exchange_spread_max
constants.source: SHARP_TRACKER_BUILD_SPEC_2026-10-14.md §5; revisit at 10k events
constants.note: exchange mid enters the ruler only when ask-bid <= this; wider is logged, flagged wide, excluded

constants.name: exchange_min_depth_usd
constants.source: Sean 10/15 (Chuba Hubbard CAR@PHI, Novig -2400 bid with $2.4k vs $61 on the other side): an exchange quote enters the ruler only with at least this many resting dollars within 3c of best ON EACH SIDE; otherwise flagged thin

constants.name: exchange_outlier_pts
constants.source: Sean 10/15: a passing exchange quote more than this far (probability points) from the median of the books on the same line is flagged outlier and excluded unless 2+ other venues sit within 3 pts of it; one big make order is not a price

constants.name: exchange_outlier_confirm
constants.source: companion to exchange_outlier_pts: venues within 3 pts needed to keep an outlying exchange quote

wind1014.desc: NFL outdoor, wind 10-14 mph (average of Open-Meteo at T-24h and MySportsWeather, whole mph): full-game under

cfb_wind14.desc: CFB outdoor, wind 14+ mph (same two-source average): full-game under

vrest8_1h.desc: NFL visitor off 8-30 days: first-half under

evidence.hold: Odds API full-game cousin 127-93-2 (+11.9%) but 48-49-2 since 2024

labs.name: Tested: NFL 1H Visitor Off 8 to 30 Days Under

awfuldog.desc: NFL dog with a season point margin of -7 to -13 (1+ games): full-game spread (re-banded 11/5; -13 or worse is paper)

bounce15_1h.desc: NFL dog whose last game lost ATS by 15+: first-half spread

labs.name: Tested: NFL 1H Blowout Bounce Dog ATS

wind1014_cold.desc: NFL outdoor, wind 10-14 mph but 35F or colder: full-game under (paper; the cold band was 27-27 in the replay, mild weather carries the rule)

evidence.train: Odds API 2020-26: wind 10-14 at 35F or colder 27-27

awfuldog_deep.desc: NFL dog with a season margin worse than -13: full-game spread (paper; 14-16 in the six-season replay)

nfl_home_dog_7510.desc: NFL home dog of +7.5 to +10 at the close: home spread

nfl_road_dog_7510.desc: NFL road dog of +7.5 to +10: road spread (paper)

evidence.hold: paper, the home version is the bet

nfl_fade_fav_bye.desc: NFL favourite coming off a bye (8+ days): take the dog on the spread (paper)

evidence.train: Odds API 2020-26: favourite off a bye 120-143-7 ATS (-9.9%)
evidence.hold: bet the dog: positive 6 of 7 seasons

nba_ats_hot_home.desc: NBA home team covering 60%+ of its spreads this season (8+ games) on exactly 2 days rest: home spread (mined 11/5)

nba_bigfav_over.desc: NBA favourite at 85%+ no-vig on the moneyline: over (mined 11/5; blowouts run up)

nhl_loss_streak_over.desc: NHL home team on a 3+ game losing streak with a season over rate of 40-60%: over (mined 11/5)

nba_badteams_under.desc: NBA visitor with a season margin of -2 to -7 at a home team winning under 40% at home (8+ games each): under (mined 11/5)

nba_roadtrip_over.desc: NBA visitor on its 4th+ straight road game that won the last meeting with this opponent: over (mined 11/5)

nhl_bounce_home_ml.desc: NHL home team off a loss by 3+ goals with a 50-64% record (8+ games): home moneyline (mined 11/5)

nhl_skid_fade_road.desc: NHL road team off a win against a home team that has lost 3+ straight: road puck line (mined 11/5)

cfb_day_over.desc: CFB game kicking off before 7pm ET with a total of 45-51.5: over (mined 11/5)

cfb_homefav_7510_under.desc: CFB home favourite of 7.5 to 10: under (mined 11/5)

mlb_road_over_under.desc: MLB road team whose games have gone over 60%+ this season (15+ games): under (mined 11/5; fires in season)

xch_homedog_fade.desc: Novig home side two-sided at 20-35c inside T-90m: take the road side on Novig

nba_momentum.desc: NBA exchange mid moved 3c+ since T-6h: continuation at that exchange

nhl_pl_fav_gap.desc: NHL favorite -1.5 when the OPPONENT's win% is 22+ points higher than the favorite's (market rates the favorite above its record)

evidence.hold: corrected replay 2020-26: 79-126 at -1.5, +1.5%; 3 of 7 seasons; Bet Labs own picks 109-138 since 2020

labs.name: Tested: NHL Puck Line Fav Win Pct Gap 22 Plus

nhl_pl_fav_strong_opp.desc: NHL favorite -1.5 when the opponent wins 66%+

evidence.hold: corrected replay (regular-season records): 136-222 at -1.5, -0.1% at Pinnacle; the 360 games Bet Labs also picks +3.6%; 2023-24 -36%

labs.name: Tested: NHL Puck Line Fav vs Opp Win Pct 66 Plus

nhl_pl_dog_bigml.desc: NHL dog +1.5 when the dog ML is +181 to +196

labs.name: Tested: NHL Puck Line Dog Open ML 181 to 196

nba_1h_under_hot_over.desc: NBA 1H under when the visitor has gone over 71%+ of the time

labs.name: Tested: NBA 1H Under Visitor Over Pct 71 Plus

nhl_early_home_fav_qual.desc: NHL home favorite, game 24 or earlier, vs an opponent winning 51%+: moneyline

evidence.hold: corrected replay 2020-26: 258-139 ML, +9.4% at Pinnacle, +9.3% at the best US book, 6 of 6 full seasons

labs.name: Tested: NHL Early Season Home Fav vs Quality Opp ML

nba_under_good_home_over.desc: NBA under: home team over 58%+, home 1-2 days off, visitor 1-3, total down 0.5+ from open

evidence.hold: Bet Labs' own picks at Pinnacle's close: 392, +7.8%; our replication with real market opens: 215-210-7, -1.3% (the two filter sets still differ on ~90 games)

labs.name: Tested: NBA Under Good Home Over Team Rest Total Down

cfb_road_dog_low_total.desc: CFB conference game, road dog of 7+ with a total of 48 or less: road spread

evidence.hold: corrected replay (conference games): 132-113-10, +4.4%, 5 of 6 full seasons; Bet Labs' own picks 153-117; non-conference version -7.2%

labs.name: Tested: CFB Conf Road Dog 7 Plus Total 48 or Less

cbb_bigloss_vs_top5.desc: CBB regular-season conference game: unranked team off a 14-45 point loss vs a top-5 opponent: that team on the spread

labs.name: Tested: CBB Unranked Off 14 Plus Loss vs Top 5 Conf

cfb_hot_over_low_total.desc: CFB non-conference game, 85F+ and wind 10 mph or less, total 55 or lower: over (heat wears defences down; low totals price it least)

labs.name: Tested: CFB Hot Weather Over Total 55 or Less

cfb_road_streak_dog.desc: CFB conference road dog on its 2nd-5th straight road game, total 54 or lower: road spread (Bet Labs also requires a heavy-bet day, which we cannot see)

labs.name: Tested: CFB Conf Road Streak Dog Total 54 or Less

cbb_under_good_over_drop.desc: CBB weekday game, home team over 50%+ and visitor over 59%+ this season (3+ games each), total down 0.5+ from open: under

evidence.hold: Bet Labs' own picks +3.5% (3 of the last 4 seasons negative); ours with real opens 495-498-11, -5.0%

labs.name: Tested: CBB Under Good Over Teams Total Down
